ignored: sh_entsize of SHT_GNU_verneed: GNU ld writes 0 (observed libz.so.1, libgcc_s.so.1) and readelf does not consult it (R:14042-14155 walks vn_next/vn_cnt).
vna_flags, vna_other, vna_hash values: emitted verbatim; no flag whitelist, no hash recomputation, no index/versym cross-check.
name bytes: decoded Latin-1 without charset or GLIBC-pattern validation.
duplicate vn_file values: emitted as separate needed[] objects; the stable sort keeps section order. No merge or dedup is performed.
vna_other: emitted raw as an unsigned 16-bit integer, including bit 15; readelf prints the same unmasked value.
section names (for example .gnu.version_r): section type is authoritative, names are not required.
program headers, .gnu.version, .gnu.version_d, dynamic entries: out of scope.
scope: bounded structural decoding of declared GNU version-need metadata in existing ELF64 little-endian x86_64/AArch64 images; success never proves loader behavior, ABI correctness, authenticity or executability
